newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 20.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Heads of state of the Entente Council, which groups Ivory Coast, Togo, Benin, Niger and Burkina Faso, meet in Ivory Coast's political capital Yamoussoukro to promote cooperation.

- New managing director of multinationl carrier Air Afrique Sir Harry K. Tirvengadum sets priorities; wants to tackle debt burden first but flight security, staff and budget issues also on his agenda.

- Journalists working for Ivorian television's main channel and belonging to the Ivorian broadcasting trades union SYPERTI say censorship of their reports, particularly concerning the crisis in the country's universities, is putting them at risk and making it more and more difficult for them to work on campus.
- Lack of hotel rooms poses problem for expansion of tourism in Ivory Coast, official figures suggest.
- West Africa Rice Development Association WARDA develops high yielding and resistant variety of rice suited to local conditions.

- Ivorian parliament begins special session; deputes to consider draft laws or amendments to laws on fake money, exchange control breaches, on the composition and organisation of the Supreme Court and a book on tax procedures.
- African Development Bank to provide 10 billion CFA francs to finance mini-projects in the private sector through Non-governmental organisations (NGOs).
- Islamic Development Bank and Ivorian Moslem students organisation AEEMCI to organise seminar from February 24 to March 3 on funding development along Islamic financing principles.
